IC1: Aged 18 years or older, male [OR] or female.
IC2: Systolic heart failure [AND] with New York Heart Association (NYHA) class II-III.
IC3: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) [AND] less than 40% by echocardiography during screening and randomization.
IC4: SCH (TSH: upper limits of normal (ULN) -10mIU/L, and FT4 level within reference range).
IC5: Having received standard HF therapy for at least 2 weeks, having reached target dose [OR] or max tolerable dose.
